newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk public workers reach agreement-minister.
newsitem.headline: Turk public workers reach agreement-minister.

text.p: Turkish State Minister Nevzat Ercan said a collective agreement had been reached with the 500,000-strong public sector labour confederation Turk-Is, Anatolian news agency said on Sunday.
"State Minister Nevzat Ercan said that at meetings between the unions belonging to Turk-Is and the Public Employers Union an agreement had been reached," Anatolian said.
Anatolian provided no details of the settlement and Turk-Is officials were not immediately available for comment.

On Thursday Turk-Is members stepped up industrial action aimed at forcing the government to accept its terms with 22,000 workers at Turkey's state oil and petrochemical plants blocking shipments and 34,000 arms industry workers holding marches.
The coalition had offered to increase salaries by 38 percent plus a 10.6 million lira payment for the first six months of the year with inflation-linked increments every six months.
Turk-Is demanded a 42 percent rise and 11.5 million payment for the first six months of the year, plus rises every six months in line with inflation.
